card.name: Comparison words before a quantity
card.fires_on: Words that set up a comparison with a number about to follow, such as 'equivalent to', 'equal to', 'more than', 'only' and 'less than'. It responds on the word or the space just before the figure.

modes.label: Equivalence phrases
modes.description: The 'to' or following space after 'equivalent' or 'equal', before a size or amount.
modes.example: rainforest land equivalent<< to>> 300 football fields in size

modes.label: More, less or only before a figure
modes.description: Quantity words such as 'more than', 'less than' or 'only' right before a number.
modes.example: the United States seizes less<< than>> 20 percent of the drugs that

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese words for 'average', 'almost', 'none at all' and 'higher by', which are words for stating how an amount compares.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to give a number by comparing it to something, as in 'equal to' or 'more than'.
